body.x: COREVALUE, led by CEO Yoo Hyun-min, participated in CES 2024 held in Las Vegas from January 9 to 12.

COREVALUE has developed a comprehensive healthcare solution based on a broad definition of health. Recognizing the importance of the interaction and connection between physical and mental health, the company secures technology to enhance both simultaneously, aiming to achieve overall health and well-being in society.

The smart healthcare solution ‘Dr.Clobo’ developed by COREVALUE focuses on improving the quality of remote healthcare, combining excellent camera and optical technology with security and performance. The product features a multifunctional camera system with three special lenses optimized for specific medical examinations.

The device is equipped with lenses for inspecting the ears and nose internally and for skin and scalp examinations simultaneously. Dr.Clobo provides effective screening and monitoring functions for early detection, managing various conditions, and continuously tracking the patient’s state.

The first lens specializes in oral and laryngeal examinations. It captures high-resolution images inside the mouth and larynx, displaying the medical condition related to the examination area, enabling accurate diagnosis and monitoring by medical professionals.

Dr. Clobo’s advanced lens system captures examination images and videos, which are transmitted in real time to medical professionals through the remote healthcare network. This offers significant advantages to patients needing help visiting medical facilities such as hospitals and clinics. COREVALUE showcased the second generation of this Dr.Clobo solution at CES 2024, attracting attention from various medical industry professionals of different nationalities.

Yoo Hyun-min, CEO of COREVALUE, stated, “Through Dr.Clobo, we aim to present a new paradigm in modern healthcare services, and specifically, our goal is to enter the global medical device and healthcare market.” He explained the reason for participating in the exhibition.

He continued, “This year at CES, I am pleased to meet multinational buyers, investors, and potential customers who want to benchmark Korea’s advanced medical system through Dr.Clobo, not only in North America but also in Korea.” He added, “Especially as Dr.Clobo has attracted significant interest in its excellent functionality and effects in Turkey, we expect to create tangible results in Europe and other regions in the future.”

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is held in Las Vegas every January, providing a comprehensive view of global technology industry trends. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies and conducting ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA’ selections. Additionally, through ‘AVING LIVE,’ they provide live coverage of CES issues.

The CES 2024 Seoul Pavilion operated on the most historical scale since Seoul’s first participation in CES in 2020, with the largest exhibition area, number of participating companies, and supporter numbers. Seoul Metropolitan Government collaborated with 13 institutions to design The Seoul Pavilion, which is essential in Seoul’s endeavors to establish Seoul as a startup hub. Among the participating companies in the Seoul Pavilion, 17 received innovation awards, proving their capabilities. Collaborated institutions include Seoul Business Agency, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul Campus Town, Yangjae Innovation Hub, Gwanak-gu, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, and Kyunghee University, totaling 13. Seoul City and institutions and supporters participating in industry-academic cooperation are matched 1:1 with companies, with a maximum of 85 supporters participating.
